scope: bounded synthetic pilot, fragment postprocessing not encoder training or new functional motif evidence
cluster_pairing: fixed Discovery PCA and KMeans; all5 variants reuse exact labels/distances and closest window per promoter per cluster

alignment.seed_rule: closest selected window to cluster center; no reference or truth
alignment.score: zero-order log odds using Discovery blank composition
alignment.offset_rule: relative to original selected start; never cumulative; skip out-of-bounds
alignment.template_update: after each round, PWM from oriented actual DNA fragments, pseudocount0.5
alignment.note: post-cluster DNA refinement; aligns candidate fragments only, never reverses parent TSS sequence

background_rejection.calibration: Discovery blank double-strand maximum-score distribution for raw or RC_SHIFT stem PWM
background_rejection.action: reject low-scoring selected instances, require at least20 retained promoters; rebuild PWM once, no retuning
background_rejection.scope: post-cluster instance rejection; not a replacement clustering algorithm

evaluation.family_selection: evaluation-only full-width best-reference mapping; not unsupervised absolute precision
evaluation.null_reports: all-candidate per-PWM FPR and any-candidate family FPR, regardless of reference gate

test_policy: all configurations fixed and all PWM outputs locked before Development/Test scoring; no truth in alignment or rejection; future method changes require new Test seeds
statistics: average2 clustering seeds per data seed first;3 data seeds are independent synthetic repeats; describe ranges, no general stability claim
